description: 新竹市中央管轄河川資料 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 工務處. 是屬於跨區域排水，提供之基本資訊如：管理機關、水系別、河川名稱、原公告河川界點、新增修河川界點、流經縣市. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 工務處. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx, csv, xml, json. The portal shows 2025-11-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
